port.description: Port StreamPulse serves its pages, API and overlay WebSocket on

configPath.description: StreamPulse config.json (kept outside the bundle so updates never touch it)

dataDir.description: StreamPulse data folder (mount as a Docker volume)

serverPath.description: Optional path to a local StreamPulse server.js (development only)

replicants.description: Replicants to share with StreamPulse overlays as {{rep.<bundle>.<name>.<path>}}

tiltifyDonations.description: Forward new Tiltify donations (donations replicant) to StreamPulse donation alerts, goals and stats

bundle.description: Bundle that owns the donations replicant

legacyCommands.description: Publish legacy built-in chat command replies (!schedule, !recent, !gamestats, !host, !commentators, !players) as {{rep.streampulse.cmd.<name>}}

bundle.description: Bundle that owns scheduleData, playersData, gameSessionLog, webhookDonations and chatCommands

tiltifyBundle.description: Bundle that owns the alldonations replicant

publicPort.description: Host port StreamPulse is published on (Docker mapping), used by the dashboard panels. Defaults to port

tlsKey.description: TLS key for HTTPS (empty string serves plain HTTP)

publicUrl.description: Browser-facing StreamPulse URL (e.g. a DSM reverse proxy with a trusted certificate). Overrides protocol/publicPort in the dashboard panels
